description: Configuration file for Internet Health Monitor. Edit these values to customize the application behavior.

monitoring.comment: sampleWindow: Number of recent samples to keep. pingIntervalMs: How often to ping (milliseconds). pingTimeoutMs: Timeout for each ping.

router.comment: Latency above this value (ms) is considered 'loss' for router pings

internet.comment: Latency above this value (ms) is considered 'loss' for internet pings

targets.comment: DNS servers to test internet connectivity. Options: Google DNS (8.8.8.8, 8.8.4.4), Cloudflare (1.1.1.1, 1.0.0.1), OpenDNS (208.67.222.222, 208.67.220.220), Quad9 (9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112)

ui.comment: logAllPings: true = log every ping, false = log only problems

advanced.comment: If autoDetectGateway fails, fallbackGateway will be used
